Name: Jonadab
Summary: Jonadab, son of Rechab, commanded his descendants to drink no wine, build no houses, sow no seed, and live in tents; generations later his sons still obeyed him, and Jeremiah held their obedience up against Judah's refusal to obey God.
KeyStory: Jonadab's command outlived him by centuries: his sons refused Jeremiah's wine in the temple because their father had forbidden it.
LifeLesson: A father's faithful command can echo for generations — and God notices when children keep it better than his own people keep his.
